observations.detail: This repo uses a lightweight custom test harness (test/assert functions with tsx runner) instead of Jest or Vitest. New tests should follow the same pattern found in src/__tests__/query-sanitize.test.ts.

Middleware is placed in src/middleware/. The rate-limit module exports types (RateLimitStore, RateLimitRequest, RateLimitResponse) for extensibility and a MemoryStore class as the default store implementation.
The project uses ESM (type: module in package.json) with .js extensions in import paths even for TypeScript files. All imports must use the .js extension.

Chose sliding window algorithm (array of timestamps pruned per request) over fixed-window counter to prevent burst allowance at window boundaries. Trade-off: slightly more memory per key but more accurate rate limiting.

Rate limiting documentation lives in docs/guides/rate-limiting.md. It was expanded from a 1-line stub to full middleware usage docs including config options table, custom keyGenerator, custom store, and sliding window explanation.

The master branch has no src/__tests__/ directory or src/sanitize/ directory — those exist only on the fix/special-chars-query-params branch. The test script in package.json on master was a placeholder echo command.
No git remote is configured on this repo, so PRs cannot be pushed to a remote. Branch was created locally at feature/rate-limiting-middleware.
